Job Advertisement


Chef – Full Time
Business: Nepalaya Hospitality Group Pty Ltd (ABN 29 639 400 963) trading as Namaste Sydney
Location: 307 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia
Website: https://namasterestro.com.au/
Occupation: Chef (ANZSCO 351311)
Salary Range: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
Employment Type: Full-time (minimum 38 hours per week)

Job Published: 27 July 2026
Applications Close: 28 August 2026

ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Nepalaya Hospitality Group Pty Ltd, trading as Namaste Sydney, operates a well-established full-service restaurant in the heart of Sydney CBD and forms part of a growing hospitality group with multiple hospitality venues. The restaurant has established a strong reputation for delivering quality à la carte dining, exceptional customer service, and a consistently high standard of hospitality.
Operating within a modern commercial kitchen, Namaste Sydney offers a diverse à la carte menu prepared using quality ingredients and established culinary techniques. The restaurant caters to a broad customer base in a fast-paced dining environment and is committed to maintaining excellence in food quality, presentation, operational efficiency, and compliance with Australian food safety standards.
Due to continued business growth and increasing customer demand, Nepalaya Hospitality Group Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced Chef to support kitchen operations, contribute to menu development, maintain consistent food quality, and assist in delivering an exceptional dining experience.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Chef will be responsible for planning, organising, and supervising food preparation and cooking activities within a busy commercial kitchen. Working collaboratively with management and kitchen staff, the successful candidate will ensure the consistent preparation and presentation of high-quality à la carte meals while maintaining operational efficiency, food safety compliance, and exceptional customer satisfaction.
The role requires a motivated hospitality professional with strong technical cooking skills, sound organisational capability, and the ability to coordinate kitchen activities during high-volume service periods. The successful candidate will also contribute to menu planning, food costing, stock management, quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives to support the efficient operation of the kitchen.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Core Culinary Operations
1.	Plan, organise and coordinate daily food preparation and cooking activities in accordance with operational requirements and anticipated service demands, ensuring kitchen readiness before each service period.
2.	Prepare, cook and present high-quality à la carte meals using a range of commercial cooking techniques while maintaining consistency in flavour, quality, presentation and portion control.
3.	Coordinate kitchen workflow during busy lunch and dinner services to ensure efficient meal production, timely service delivery, and effective communication between kitchen and front-of-house staff.
4.	Monitor food quality throughout all stages of preparation and service, ensuring ingredients are fresh and finished dishes consistently meet established quality standards.
5.	Maintain consistency in recipe execution, presentation standards and quality assurance across all menu offerings while ensuring customer expectations are consistently achieved.

Menu Planning and Development
1.	Assist in planning, reviewing and refining menus to maintain product quality, seasonal relevance and commercial competitiveness.
2.	Develop and recommend seasonal specials and new menu items based on customer preferences, market trends and ingredient availability.
3.	Support recipe standardisation, food costing and portion control to maximise operational efficiency while maintaining profitability.
4.	Evaluate customer feedback and menu performance to identify opportunities for continuous menu improvement and innovation.
5.	Participate in menu trials and product development initiatives to enhance the restaurant's culinary offerings.

Kitchen Operations and Inventory Management
1.	Manage inventory through effective ordering, receiving, storage and stock rotation procedures to maintain appropriate stock levels.
2.	Apply FIFO inventory management principles and monitor ingredient usage to minimise food wastage and maximise product quality.
3.	Conduct regular stocktakes and assist in monitoring food costs through effective inventory management practices.
4.	Liaise with suppliers regarding product quality, deliveries and stock availability to ensure uninterrupted kitchen operations.
5.	Maintain accurate purchasing, inventory and stock control records in accordance with business procedures.

Team Leadership and Kitchen Coordination
1.	Work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house teams to ensure efficient communication and coordinated service delivery.
2.	Support, mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to junior kitchen staff to maintain productivity, consistency and professional kitchen standards.
3.	Assist in allocating daily kitchen duties and coordinating workflow to maximise operational efficiency during service periods.
4.	Promote a positive, organised and team-oriented kitchen environment focused on quality, accountability and continuous improvement.
5.	Contribute to staff training by reinforcing food preparation techniques, food safety practices and operational procedures.

Food Safety, Hygiene and Compliance
1.	Maintain compliance with HACCP principles, NSW Food Authority requirements and all relevant food safety legislation.
2.	Ensure kitchen equipment, food preparation areas and storage facilities are maintained in a clean, organised and hygienic condition at all times.
3.	Monitor food storage temperatures, sanitation procedures and food handling practices to ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements.
4.	Ensure compliance with Workplace Health and Safety obligations and the safe operation of commercial kitchen equipment.
5.	Maintain accurate food safety documentation, cleaning schedules and operational records to support regulatory compliance.


Operational Administration
1.	Complete kitchen records relating to stock usage, food safety, cleaning schedules and wastage reporting accurately and on time.
2.	Assist management in identifying opportunities to improve kitchen efficiency, food quality, operational productivity and customer satisfaction.
3.	Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance restaurant operations, service standards and overall business performance.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
1.	AQF Advanced Diploma or Diploma in Hospitality, Commercial Cookery or a closely related discipline.
2.	Minimum 2 years' full-time relevant experience as a Chef within a commercial restaurant environment.
3.	Demonstrated experience preparing and delivering high-quality à la carte cuisine within a busy commercial kitchen.
4.	Strong knowledge of HACCP principles, NSW Food Safety Standards and food handling legislation.
5.	Sound understanding of Workplace Health and Safety obligations within hospitality environments.
6.	Experience in menu planning, stock control, purchasing procedures and kitchen coordination.

KEY COMPETENCIES
1.	Strong culinary expertise across a broad range of commercial cooking techniques and food preparation methods.
2.	Demonstrated ability to coordinate kitchen operations during high-volume service periods while maintaining quality, consistency and efficiency.
3.	Sound understanding of menu development, food costing, recipe standardisation and portion control principles.
4.	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
5.	Leadership capability to supervise, mentor and support kitchen staff within a collaborative team environment.
6.	Strong communication and interpersonal skills when working with management, kitchen staff and front-of-house pers

result.description:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd
Walkaway, Western Australia

Full Time Irrigationist 
(2 Positions Available)

Salary
AUD $90,000 – $100,000 per annum plus Superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

About us:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd is a family-owned agricultural enterprise based in Walkaway, Western Australia, approximately 30 minutes from Geraldton. We operate approximately 4.2 hectares of plastic greenhouses in Walkaway and an additional 2 hectares of plastic greenhouses at the family’s original farm.

We are currently expanding our operations, having purchased 60 acres of land near Walkaway to support future growth and long-term sustainability. NVD Fresh Produce specialises in intensive greenhouse cultivation and is progressively diversifying its crop range, recognising crop rotation as a key strategy to preserve soil health, improve productivity, and maintain consistent supply.
The business is focused on strengthening its production capacity, improving operational systems and water management practices, and establishing a scalable and sustainable structure to support ongoing expansion within Western Australia’s fresh produce market.

The successful applicant will play an important role in supporting the continued growth and success of NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations.

Position Summary
The Irrigationist is responsible for installing, operating, monitoring and maintaining irrigation systems across NVD Fresh Produce's greenhouse and farming operations. The role supports efficient and sustainable water management by ensuring irrigation systems operate effectively to maximise crop productivity, water efficiency and workplace safety.

Key Responsibilities
Irrigation System Management
•	Determine hydraulic parameters for irrigation systems. 
•	Implement irrigation programs to meet crop production requirements. 
•	Schedule irrigation activities based on crop and seasonal requirements. 
•	Select, operate and manage irrigation pumps and related equipment. 
Irrigation Operations
•	Interpret irrigation plans and apply irrigation designs. 
•	Install, monitor and maintain irrigation systems. 
•	Identify and rectify faults in irrigation infrastructure. 
•	Monitor irrigation performance, water usage and system efficiency.
Farm Operations
•	Maintain irrigation equipment, pipelines, valves, filtration systems and controllers.
